projects.name: Tapinfi
projects.imageAlt: Tapinfi NFC digital business card and storefront visual showcase
projects.shortDesc: NFC digital business card platform with instant tap-to-save mobile profiles.
projects.challenge: Teams needed a zero-app paperless card that opens fast on every phone.
projects.objective: Pair tactile NFC hardware storytelling with an instant mobile vCard experience.
projects.strategy: Sub-second profile rendering, one-tap contact saving, and modular team themes.

execution.design: Modular digital card layouts, tactile mockups, and crisp mobile typography.
execution.development: Fast web profile renderer, instant vCard generation, and product site.
execution.marketing: Conversion product copy and rich social link previews.

projects.results: 0.9s mobile profile render with frictionless contact saving across iOS and Android.
projects.clientFeedback: Sample showcase: crisp product clarity built for instant networking.

projects.name: CafeOS
projects.imageAlt: CafeOS hospitality and cafe operations interface illustration
projects.shortDesc: High-contrast cafe billing and kitchen queue OS built for fast counter staff.
projects.challenge: Busy cafes juggle counter orders and kitchen queues on clunky legacy screens.
projects.objective: Cut order taps and make status cards readable across crowded counters.
projects.strategy: High-contrast colour status blocks and dedicated counter vs. kitchen views.

execution.design: Touch-first order tiles, kitchen display cards, and high-contrast tokens.
execution.development: Real-time order queue state and modular tablet-ready views.
execution.marketing: Speed-focused onboarding narrative for hospitality founders.

projects.results: Reduced counter billing flow to 3 taps with clear kitchen ticket tracking.
projects.clientFeedback: Sample showcase: built for fast staff adoption during rush hours.

projects.name: Vyapaar Saathi
projects.imageAlt: Vyapaar Saathi business workflow platform and analytics illustration
projects.shortDesc: Bilingual SME workflow platform designed in plain English and Hinglish.
projects.challenge: Indian SME owners tuned out dense enterprise software jargon.
projects.objective: Unite approachable bilingual UX with automated WhatsApp onboarding.
projects.strategy: Plain Hinglish clarity paired with high-trust visual cues and instant demos.

execution.design: Friendly visual hierarchy, warm Jaipur palette, and step-by-step flows.
execution.development: Responsive web platform, WhatsApp onboarding, and modular dashboards.
execution.marketing: SME search architecture and regional campaign hooks.

projects.results: Streamlined bilingual SME onboarding with automated WhatsApp follow-up.
projects.clientFeedback: Sample showcase: clarity-first design for pan-India SMB adoption.
